scenarios.title: A｜自我介绍
scenarios.setting: 玩家第一天上班，经理把玩家介绍给旁边的同事。

turns.text: Hi! You must be the new person on the team. I’m Jamie.

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’m Alex. Nice to meet you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m Alex. Nice to meet you.
feedback.explanation: 初次见面时表达友好，配合姓名或简短自我介绍就能开启交流。

choices.text: Yeah, today’s my first day. I’m Alex. Nice to meet you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, today’s my first day. I’m Alex. Nice to meet you.
feedback.explanation: 初次见面时表达友好，配合姓名或简短自我介绍就能开启交流。

choices.text: Hi! I’ve just joined the team. I’m Alex.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi! I’ve just joined the team. I’m Alex.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: Nice to meet you. I’m really excited to be here.

feedback.naturalExpression: Nice to meet you. I’m really excited to be here.
feedback.explanation: 初次见面时表达友好，配合姓名或简短自我介绍就能开启交流。

choices.text: Hi, I’m the new colleague.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m Alex. Nice to meet you.
feedback.explanation: 新人介绍通常说“I’m new here”再报姓名；“the new colleague”像用标签代替自我介绍。

turns.text: Nice to meet you too. How’s your first day going?

turns.prompt: 你想分享上班第一天的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: Pretty good so far. I’m still getting used to everything.

feedback.naturalExpression: Pretty good so far. I’m still getting used to everything.
feedback.explanation: “getting used to”表示正在适应，后接名词或动词 -ing 形式。

choices.text: Good, thanks. There’s a lot to take in, though.

feedback.naturalExpression: Good, thanks. There’s a lot to take in, though.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: It’s going well. Everyone’s been really helpful.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s going well. Everyone’s been really helpful.
feedback.explanation: “really helpful”明确表示信息或帮助有用，让对方知道这次回应解决了需要。

choices.text: A little overwhelming, but in a good way.

feedback.naturalExpression: A little overwhelming, but in a good way.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: I’m still getting familiar with everything.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Pretty good so far. I’m still getting used to everything.
feedback.explanation: 这句正确，表示仍在熟悉环境；“getting used to everything”更口语化，偏重逐渐适应。

turns.text: Don’t worry. The first few days are always like that.

turns.prompt: 关于「第一天认识同事」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, I’m sure I’ll get the hang of it soon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’m sure I’ll get the hang of it soon.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks. I’m looking forward to getting started.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’m looking forward to getting started.
feedback.explanation: “looking forward to”表示期待，后接名词或动词的 -ing 形式。

choices.text: That’s good to hear. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s good to hear. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: B｜认识团队
scenarios.setting: 在“第一天认识同事”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“认识团队”。

turns.text: Have you met everyone on the team yet?

turns.prompt: 关于「第一天认识同事」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Not yet. I’ve only met a few people so far.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not yet. I’ve only met a few people so far.
feedback.explanation: “not yet”表示目前还没有，但之后仍可能发生；与绝对否定不同。

choices.text: I’ve met Jamie and Chris, but that’s about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve met Jamie and Chris, but that’s about it.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: Not everyone. I’m still trying to remember everyone’s names.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not everyone. I’m still trying to remember everyone’s names.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: I don’t think I’ve met the whole team yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think I’ve met the whole team yet.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: I haven’t met everyone already.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not yet. I’ve only met a few people so far.
feedback.explanation: 否定句表示“还没”通常用“yet”；“I haven’t met everyone yet”表示仍有部分人未认识。

turns.text: That’s Chris over there. He handles most of our client communication.

turns.prompt: 你想了解团队成员的职责和协作关系，会怎么说？

choices.text: And who does he work with most closely?

feedback.naturalExpression: And who does he work with most closely?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: What does Jamie work on?

feedback.naturalExpression: What does Jamie work on?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: Who should I talk to if I have questions about the project?

feedback.naturalExpression: Who should I talk to if I have questions about the project?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Who’s in charge of our team?

feedback.naturalExpression: Who’s in charge of our team?
feedback.explanation: 用简短问句核对刚听到的信息，省略的部分由前面的对话补足，适合当面确认细节。

turns.text: Morgan is our team lead. You’ll probably be working with her quite a lot.

turns.prompt: 关于「第一天认识同事」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Got it. I’ll introduce myself to her later.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’ll introduce myself to her later.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay. Is she the person I should go to if I have questions?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Is she the person I should go to if I have questions?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: Great. I’m looking forward to working with everyone.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’m looking forward to working with everyone.
feedback.explanation: “looking forward to”表示期待，后接名词或动词的 -ing 形式。

scenarios.title: C｜简单聊自己的工作
scenarios.setting: 在“第一天认识同事”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“简单聊自己的工作”。

turns.text: So, what will you be working on here?

turns.prompt: 关于「第一天认识同事」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ll mainly be working on the new project with the design team.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll mainly be working on the new project with the design team.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: I’m joining the design team as a junior designer.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m joining the design team as a junior designer.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I’ll mostly be helping with visual design and research.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll mostly be helping with visual design and research.
feedback.explanation: “mostly”限定为主要情况，说明还有其他可能，而不是一概而论。

choices.text: I’m not completely sure yet. I’m meeting with my manager later today.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not completely sure yet. I’m meeting with my manager later today.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: My work is mainly do design.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll mainly be working on the new project with the design team.
feedback.explanation: 说明主要工作可用“My work mainly involves design”；“is mainly do”缺少合适的动词结构。

turns.text: Nice. Have you done similar work before?

turns.prompt: 关于「第一天认识同事」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yeah, I worked on a similar project at my last company.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I worked on a similar project at my last company.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: A little. This role is slightly different from my previous one.

feedback.naturalExpression: A little. This role is slightly different from my previous one.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: Not exactly, but I have some experience in this area.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not exactly, but I have some experience in this area.
feedback.explanation: “exactly”强调信息吻合或需要精确确认，适合核对具体细节。

choices.text: This is actually my first job in this kind of role.

feedback.naturalExpression: This is actually my first job in this kind of role.
feedback.explanation: “kind of”口语中表示有点、算是，常用来缓和对自身或事情的描述。

turns.text: Well, feel free to ask if you need any help.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks, I really appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks, I really appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: I will. I’m sure I’ll have plenty of questions at first.

feedback.naturalExpression: I will. I’m sure I’ll have plenty of questions at first.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks. I’ll definitely let you know if I get stuck.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’ll definitely let you know if I get stuck.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
